messages:
lee: Quick report: customers seeing 500s after upgrading to @redwood/inference@1.3.0. Error in server logs: Error: Cannot find module './dist/index.cjs'

pat: Did we accidentally change the publish config to include src instead of dist?

nora: I pulled the tarball (npm pack) and the package only contains package.json, src/, README.md and types/ — no compiled JS. release-bot: publish job marked success but with warning: \"no files matched dist/**\"

lee: Oof. That explains Edge runtime breakages too — Edge hosts need native ESM (.mjs) not TS source.

pat: We should unpublish or deprecate immediately. Also prepare 1.3.1 with compiled outputs (dist/index.cjs + dist/index.mjs) and source maps.

nora: For package.json please set: main -> ./dist/index.cjs, module -> ./dist/index.mjs, types -> ./dist/index.d.ts, and exports mapping for import/require. Add \"files\": [\"dist\"] so npm pack includes it.

lee: Also add a small smoke test in CI: run npm pack and extract tarball, then check that dist/index.cjs exists and require.resolve('.') works in node. For edge test do an esbuild bundle targeting \"browser\"/\"esnext\" to ensure the import entrypoint is valid.

pat: I'll cut a hotfix branch and push compiled artifacts. Who can review quickly? @nora?

nora: I can review. Also update quickstarts in docs so they pin prior working version until hotfix lands. docs: can you add a note?

docs: On it. I'll add a temporary banner to the quickstart: \"If you see module resolution errors, pin to @redwood/inference@1.2.x until 1.3.1 is published.\"

lee: Postmortem items: release checklist that verifies dist presence, include source maps in package, and ensure types point to emitted d.ts. Also add a lint rule in repo that warns if package.json files list doesn't include dist.

pat: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/483 (hotfix: include dist outputs, add CI smoke tests, fix exports map). Please review and merge fast.
_meta: Slack thread about npm publish missing dist artifacts, ESM/CJS entrypoints, and source maps.
